closingLine: Normal CI tells you whether code still runs. Agentdiff tells you whether the agent's behavior boundary changed.

shots.title: Evidence loop
shots.caption: Evidence loop: 10 verified cases became 22.
shots.voiceover: This came from a repeatable evidence loop: mine public agent PRs read-only, find detector gaps, fix them, rerun. Normal CI tells you whether code still runs. Agentdiff tells you whether the agent's behavior boundary changed.
